241	Achra, they would be pure, not impure, they would not be predators,
242	for example.
243	As it will be in the future to come: "The lion shall eat straw like the ox, and the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard lie down with the kid."
244	That is, the Sitra Achra is here in the role of creating the screen of concealment.
245	But the vitality is not hers, the vitality belongs to holiness.
246	And what is the second thing the Sitra Achra impresses us with?
247	With the illusion it creates for us.
248	It creates for us an illusion that its size and its power are what rules, what
249	runs things, and what decides.
250	All this tremendous power of the Sitra Achra that impresses us so much is, as we said before, not
251	the first part, that all it has is not its own,
252	but rather that all it has has no reality at all.
253	There is no such thing, it is all illusion.
254	So if there is such an illusion, where does this illusion come from?
255	The Alter Rebe will explain that this illusion is a deliberate illusion that comes from the Holy One, blessed be He.
256	The Holy One, blessed be He, wants this illusion.
257	This is the purpose of the Sitra Achra, to produce for us this false display.
258	Let us see it inside the text.
259	He says: "For all its vitality, as
260	we said, is not from itself, heaven forbid."
261	Its vitality, which is all it has, is not its own, but apparently comes from holiness.
262	And therefore, from the standpoint of truth, it is completely nullified
263	before holiness.
264	Whenever it stands against holiness, one immediately sees the truth that all it has is not its own.
265	And as we said before, a little light repels much darkness.
266	"And it is nullified to holiness like the nullification of darkness before the light of a candle."
267	If so, the opposite question arises, regarding what we said before: if
268	so, how does it deceive us and create for us a false display
269	of something so powerful, that is seemingly the ruler and master of all
270	reality?
271	So here is the deliberate concealment that HaShem created, and what is it?
272	…
273	That with regard to the holiness of the divine soul
274	within man.
275	The Holy One, blessed be He, who created man and gave him a holy soul, a divine soul,
276	and an animal soul as well, wanted
277	the animal soul, whose source is in the klipah, to have the power to conceal the light of holiness of
278	the divine soul.
279	And there is a purpose in this concealment.
